description: This file defines an API class `CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI` for scheduling, retrieving, and updating interview details related to candidates within a recruitment module. It handles HTTP requests, validation, transaction management, and interacts with various services and entities to manage candidate interviews in the OrangeHRM recruitment system.

classes.name: CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI
classes.description: API class for managing candidate interview scheduling operations such as creating, retrieving, and updating interview details within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented, intended to fetch all candidate interviews.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented, intended to provide validation rules for fetching all interviews.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles scheduling a new interview for a candidate, including validation, transaction management, and interaction with data access objects.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves candidate ID from request parameters.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Populates an Interview entity with data from the request, including setting interview details and interviewers.

methods.name: setCandidateHistory
methods.description: Creates a candidate history record for interview scheduling action, associating candidate, vacancy, and interview details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new interview, including checks on input fields.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for request bodies related to interview scheduling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, would handle deletion of an interview if supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented, would provide validation rules for deleting an interview.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific interview by candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a specific interview.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates details of an existing interview for a candidate.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an interview.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves interview ID from request parameters.
